287692
echo "===== 部署 doudizhu_engine.py $(date '+%F %T') ====="
cd /root/bot/bot
B64=''
# 1) 备份线上原文(若存在)
if [ -f "doudizhu_engine.py" ]; then cp -f "doudizhu_engine.py" "doudizhu_engine.py.bak_1123" && echo "已备份 -> doudizhu_engine.py.bak_1123"; else echo "线上无此文件,跳过备份"; fi
# 2) 解码+解压还原
printf '%s' "$B64" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | gzip -dc > "doudizhu_engine.py.new"
if [ $? -ne 0 ] || [ ! -s "doudizhu_engine.py.new" ]; then echo "【失败】解码/解压失败,不覆盖线上"; exit 1; fi
# 3) 校验新文件md5
GOT=$(md5sum "doudizhu_engine.py.new" | awk '{print $1}')
echo "期望md5=3a2b7c2912e9103f5b92217c633009e4"
echo "实际md5=$GOT"
if [ "$GOT" != "3a2b7c2912e9103f5b92217c633009e4" ]; then echo "【失败】md5不符,不覆盖线上,删除临时"; rm -f "doudizhu_engine.py.new"; exit 1; fi
# 4) 语法校验
/root/bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile "doudizhu_engine.py.new" 2>&1 && echo "语法OK" || { echo "【失败】语法错误,不覆盖线上"; rm -f "doudizhu_engine.py.new"; exit 1; }
# 5) 原子替换
mv -f "doudizhu_engine.py.new" "doudizhu_engine.py" && echo "【成功】doudizhu_engine.py 已覆盖"
md5sum "doudizhu_engine.py"
echo "===== 部署 doudizhu_engine.py 完 ====="
